answer: Sybil mills spin lookalike sellers to flood a thin catalog. A new merchant lodges a 19-hour cipher bond of 27 coins and publishes a 12-line fable whose trigrams collide with at most one other live listing above 0.71 Jaccard across 9 sampled 6-minute windows. A kernel of 3 reviewers recomputes those windows from the posted catalog roots and confirms the cap. They publish the 9 window hashes; any peer reruns the Jaccard checks. Two or more collisions, or fewer than 3 agreeing reviewers, slashes 70% of the bond to a rebate and burns 30%; a second miss in 11 days freezes that prefix for 14 epochs.
